description: Build verify_enrichment_wiring.py to confirm the three enrichment modules (temporal_stability_enrichment, permission_scope_enrichment, community_signal_enrichment) are correctly wired into the enrichment_harness evaluation pipeline. Must: (1) Import each new enrichment module and call compute_score with synthetic metadata dict. (2) Assert return type is tuple[float, dict] and score is in [0.0, 100.0]. (3) Query mcp_signal_enrichments table to verify rows exist for each signal type. (4) Check that signal_analyser includes these enrichments in its scoring pipeline. (5) Send heartbeat to service_health on completion. (6) Exit 0 on success, exit 1 on any assertion failure. Follows pattern from verify_supply_chain_enrichment_wired.py (2026-04-30).
